digest/blocks#

Infrastructure for digests of 64-byte blocks with a 64-bit length trailer, as MD5 and SHA-1 are built.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Infrastructure for digests of 64-byte blocks with a 64-bit length trailer, as MD5 and SHA-1 are built. Use the digests themselves, not this.

object DigestBlocks64#

object DigestBlocks64

A lazy byte history with an unfinalized compression state. Construction binds bytes without calling compression. bytes() compresses and pads a temporary state; it never finalizes this receiver. state(chunk) compresses this input's full blocks, saves at most 63 tail bytes and binds the new chunk unevaluated. It retains no earlier input arrays or chain of prior histories. Repeats and branches are deterministic for a pure compression collaborator.

let continued = history.state([byte(0), byte(255)]);
continued.bytes(); // history.bytes() remains independently available

Length is limited to 2^61-1 bytes; append checks before calling compression. Integer shifts encode the unsigned bit-length trailer without signed overflow. Work is linear in pending input, auxiliary storage bounded by block/state size (apart from the bound input array). There is no I/O, buffer handle or close.
